name: Teton County Democratic Party
description: The Teton County Democratic Party works together for the social, environmental, and economic well-being of our community through education, advocacy, and elections.

hero.headline: Working together for the well-being of Teton County
hero.subline: Through education, advocacy, and elections. Everyone is welcome.

election.votingText: Early and absentee voting begins October 6. In Teton County you can register and vote the same day, all the way through Election Day.
